segments.description: Close-up shot showing apple-infused batter being stirred in a glass bowl.
Demonstrating adding semolina and water together in a bowl, then mixing.
Pouring semolina mixture and cooked rice into a blender jar.
Blending ingredients into a smooth batter and pouring into a bowl.
Grating an apple onto an orange plate.
Seasoning batter with salt and coriander leaves, stirring thoroughly.
Adding grated apple into the batter mix.
Greasing heated pan and pouring batter to make thin pancakes.
Covering pan with a lid, then flipping and cooking the pancake to golden perfection.
Plating ready apple pancakes neatly on a white plate.

hook.opening_visual: Spoon mixing light-colored batter with grated fruit in a transparent glass bowl.
hook.notes: Fast visual showing the final recipe process.
